title: Bollywood Star Rambanand Sagar's 'Ramayan' Trailer Released, Sparks Controversy
summary: The trailer of Bollywood star Rambanand Sagar's upcoming film 'Ramayan', starring Ranveer Singh and Deepika Padukone, has been released. The trailer features a dramatic scene with Deepika Padukone playing the role of Sita. The film is based on the ancient Hindu epic Ramayana. The trailer has sparked controversy among fans due to its depiction of the character Kauravas as 'animals'. The government has not commented on the issue, while opposition parties have expressed concern over the film's portrayal of the characters.
